source.name: Footy Headlines, 'Panama 2026 World Cup Home, Away & Third Kits Released'
source.quote: Reebok has officially unveiled the new home, away, and third kits for the Panama national team ahead of the 2026 World Cup.
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The full launch gallery shows no commercial sponsor, only the Reebok logo and the FEPAFUT crest.

summary: No commercial shirt sponsors on Panama's 2026 World Cup home shirt. The Reebok kit (unveiled 14-16 April 2026) carries only the Reebok logo and the FEPAFUT crest; Panama24News' description of the launch mentions only the 'canaleros' inscription on the back of the neck. Kit maker Reebok is listed as partner per dataset convention.
